constraints.text: On 2026-10-12 the first `git push origin v0.3.0` failed without a visible error: the pre-push hook ran ember verify for several minutes while the ssh session to GitHub was open, and the chained `| tail -1` dropped the failure; a second push with --no-verify landed the tag.
Immediately after the tag reached GitHub, https://github.com/nickpending/prismis/archive/refs/tags/v0.3.0.tar.gz returned 404; the same request succeeded seconds later.

This Mac runs prismis-cli v0.1.0 as a uv tool and the TUI at ~/.local/bin/prismis from make install-tui; ~/.local/bin precedes Homebrew's bin on its PATH, so brew-installed binaries are shadowed until those are removed.
Security requirements: secrets stay in env or config, never inline or logged; the tap deploy key lives only in the Actions secret.
